title: EvaluatorOutput
description: Final evaluator output for the Vocabulary evaluator (grades 5-12 path). Enforced via structured output at the model call boundary -- system.txt/user.txt's own prose ("provide an answer... use only a single integer") describes a different, narrower contract than this schema requires. That mismatch is pre-existing and intentionally left in the prompt text; see config.json step description.

tier_2_words.description: List of Tier 2 words: words commonly used in academic settings, more complex than colloquial or everyday language, often with multiple meanings.

tier_3_words.description: List of Tier 3 words: overly academic or domain-specific words.

archaic_words.description: List of archaic words, or common words used in an archaic way, not commonly used in modern conversational language.

other_complex_words.description: All other words that can increase complexity of the text (e.g., idioms, unfamiliar proper nouns that function as vocabulary).

complexity_score.description: The vocabulary complexity level of the text.

reasoning.description: A detailed explanation of the rating, per the annotation guide and rubric.
